verdict.rationale: Choosing a storage region is a fair question for a cloud provider, so this axis applies. The only location-related evidence is Capacity Finder, which compares Spot Node Pool compute availability across Zones. That is compute placement, an adjacent feature, not a documented way to choose where AI Object Storage data or other data is stored or kept resident. No evidence shows region selection for buckets or any data-residency guarantee.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: use Capacity Finder in the Cloud Console to compare placement availability across Zones for your requested instance type and Node count
